_why: BUILD_DEFAULTS section 6: real data with a source and a date wherever it exists, clearly
labelled estimates otherwise, and never an invented trucking fact, rate, broker or lane.
Andrew's Freedom Trucking paperwork is the only real rate-con source and it has NOT been
supplied (seed/README.md). So: the broker is a placeholder name that cannot be mistaken
for a real MC holder, the lane is two large cities, and the figures are round numbers
chosen to exercise the parser — NOT a claim about what this lane pays.
What this fixture is FOR is the shapes, every one of which is a rule somewhere:
linehaul as formatted text with a comma       -> integer cents, no float formed (R-4)
a detention clause buried in prose            -> moneyParseIncomplete === true
a per-mile figure that states its unit        -> per_mile, never a flat rate
machine columns in the payload                -> denylisted, raw_payload only (R-5)
a source field claiming to be something else  -> provenance comes from the argument
